**Needs changes before merge** - the frame maths is sound, but the PR breaks one existing UI structural test and leaves a stale label.

Thanks for the work, @jenhaert - the core is careful. Reviewed at the high tier (part frame = geometry under the safety floor).

### What looks good
- Frame correctness (`crates/app/src/pick/axis.rs:160-228`): both pick directions are normalised in `dir_through` (zero-length refused by name), the secondary is Gram-Schmidt orthogonalised against the primary, +Z = `cross(colx, coly)` of unit orthogonal columns, so the frame is orthonormal for NON-axis-aligned edges. The landing is re-proved through the result before the command stores anything. This avoids the #706 bug.
- I tested it myself with a throwaway test (not committed): a 20x20x10 block held tilted 25 deg about Z and 37 deg about X, picks = the block's own Y and X edges. Result: unit quaternion (|q|-1 < 1e-9), picks land on +Y/+X and the block's Z on +Z within 1e-9, and the body diagonal length is preserved (no scale/shear). Same edge picked twice is refused. All passed.
- Degenerate picks: parallel/anti-parallel (within 1 deg) refused by name (`axis.rs:176`), the same edge twice falls into that case, zero-length refused, non-finite refused, no part refused, face picks refused. No unwrap/expect/panic in the new code.
- Undoable: goes through `AlignPartToSetup` (`setup_align.rs`), pre-validated by `check_align`; UI queues `CommandKind::AlignPartFromAxes`, one-undo restores (pinned in the UI test).
- Decision file present (`docs/decisions/769-align-axes.md`), `Changelog:` and `Fixes #769` present, no snapshot PNGs, no CHANGELOG edit, no process/build/dep files touched, files all under 400 lines, provenance lines present.

### Local results (trial-merged with current upstream/main, clean merge)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| app `align_axes` | 9 pass |
| app `axis_align` / `plane_align` / `points_align` / `turn_pivot` / `setup_align` / `mcp_pick` | 10 / 9 / 8 / 5 / 9 / 3 pass |
| app `--lib` | 107 pass |
| ui `--lib` (from crates/ui) | 454 pass, **1 FAIL**, 5 ignored |
| ui `setup_axis_tests` (9) | pass |
| clippy -D warnings, camcraft-app + camcraft-ui, all targets | clean |

```
---- egui_app::tests::structural::setup_page_alignment_rows_structure stdout ----
thread '...' panicked at crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/structural.rs:262:92:
the axes rows show
```

### Requested before merge
1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/structural.rs:262` still looks up the old label `"Axes in the plane - pick an edge or two points"`, but `setup_axis_pick.rs` now says `"Part axes - pick an edge or two points for +Y and +X; +Z follows by the right-hand rule"`. Update the structural assertion to the new label (AGENTS.md: a UI change updates the structural assertions). The PR's quoted battery only ran `setup_axis`, so this was missed - please run the full `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` from `crates/ui`.
2. Stale user-visible hint text still says "Axes in the plane": `crates/ui/src/plane_pick.rs:73` and `crates/app/src/pick/plane.rs:146` (and the doc comments at `setup_plane_pick.rs:3`, `mcp/align_tools.rs:4`). Point them at the renamed rows.
3. MCP: AGENTS.md requires a user-facing command to ship with an MCP tool or a named `source:agent` `MCP: <command>` follow-up issue (P1, `area:mcp`). The PR body says the MCP align tool still only turns in-plane (`mcp/align_tools.rs:62` calls `turn_in_plane`) but names no issue, and I found none. Either route that tool through `align_from_axes` or file and name the follow-up.
4. Body is missing the `Effort:` line the effort-label process asks for (#769 is `effort:high`).

### Questions / notes (not blocking)
- Skew tolerance: only picks within 1 deg of parallel are refused; a pair 30 deg off perpendicular is accepted and the secondary lands "within its skew" (documented, pinned). That is a deliberate Gram-Schmidt choice, but a user mis-pick of two near-diagonal edges lands silently; consider surfacing the skew angle in the status words ("+X lands N deg off its pick").
- Overlap: #773 (touches `pick/axis.rs`, `setup_axis_pick.rs`, `structural.rs`, `state.rs`, `axis_pick.rs`, `setup_align.rs`), #746 (`setup_align.rs`, `setup_axis_pick.rs`, `axis_pick.rs`, `state.rs`) and #706 (`axis_pick.rs`, `state.rs`) are open and will conflict with this one in the UI files; whichever merges second re-merges main. Today it merges cleanly.
- The pivot is the part bounds centre and the origin is untouched by design - fine and consistent with #557.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

**Needs changes before merge** (one small fix left; the earlier blockers are closed).

**Closed since the last review**
- `structural.rs` now asserts the "Part axes - pick an edge or two points ..." label (line 287) and passes.
- The "Part axes" rename is consistent in `plane_pick.rs:74`, `pick/plane.rs:146`, `setup_plane_pick.rs:3`, `mcp/align_tools.rs:4`.
- MCP routing is filed as #1329 (`area:mcp`, `P5`, `source:agent`) and named in the PR body, which AGENTS.md "Commands ship with an MCP tool" allows.
- No snapshot PNG changed; no `Cargo.toml`, `build.rs`, `.github/` or process-file change.

**Local results (merged with main, clean merge)**
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib -- structural setup_axis setups_declutter` (CWD `crates/ui`): 20 passed, 1 failed.
- Not run: `camcraft-app` mcp_pick and clippy (stopped at the blocker; the rest of the rename is strings and comments).

```
egui_app::tests::setups_declutter::the_setups_page_lists_setups_only_and_each_setup_page_keeps_its_settings
crates\ui\src\egui_app\tests\setups_declutter.rs:78:13:
Setup1 page shows "Axes in the plane"
```

**Requested before merge**
1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/setups_declutter.rs:13`: the `MOVED` list still names "Axes in the plane", which this PR renamed. It is asserted present on each setup's Settings page (line 78) and absent from the Setups page (lines 56ff), so it now fails, and the absent check would pass vacuously. Change it to "Part axes". A grep for the old label across `crates/` finds only this line.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
